tara: T-12m for the mid-morning change window. Quick roles: Ben pins/unpins and runs rollout commands, I'm coordinator, SRE watches infra, support-bot will prep release note snippet. @ben @sre
ben: Ready. Will pin redwood-api@dedicated after canary. Keeping rollback command handy.
deploy-bot: Planned canary rollout 1740500000 -> region: us-central1, initial 10% traffic, bake 10m. Preflight: migrations noop, config checksum ok.
sre: Alerts armed: p95 > 220ms or error-rate > 1% -> page. Watching embedding CPU and cache eviction rate.
tara: If canary shows cost-only uptick: prefer batch-size down first. Ben, have toggle script?
ben: Yep: `scripts/toggle_batch.sh redwood-api 0.6`
tara: Rollback command for quick copy:
```
# immediate rollback to last stable
kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-api --to-revision=stable-288
```
support-bot: Draft note: "Regional canary in us-central; eu rollout paused pending image digest verification." Will post in #release-notes after final pin.
sre: small p99 bump to 300ms during warmup, error-rate 0.2% — holding expansion until bake finishes.
ben: Running canary smoke now, will paste short report.
ben: smoke: 50/50 synths pass, 2 retries succeeded, embeddings diff 0.35%. Good to expand at T+12m if no regressions.
tara: OK. Hold for one more smoke at T+8m. Handover: this thread is primary comms. Locking after final pin. :lock:
